title: Right-endpoint sum
text: Divide [a,b] into $$n$$ equal pieces of width $$dx=\frac{b-a}{n}$$. $$R_n$$ adds f at the right end of each piece, then multiplies by dx.

title: Use symmetry
text: The values at $$0.1$$, ..., $$0.9$$ cancel in pairs, leaving only $$cos(pi)=-1$$. So $$R_{10}=0.1\left(-1\right)=-0.1$$.
